title: The National Judicial Office and Its President, 2012–2013
goal: I can describe the powers of the National Judicial Office and its president in 2012 and 2013, with the dates (*jogkör, kinevezés, ügyáthelyezés*).
I can name a procedure with a noun in *-ás/-és*, such as *igazgatás*, *kinevezés* or *módosítás*.
I can say what the Venice Commission and the Constitutional Court did.
